name: Assembly Biosciences, Inc.
summary: Assembly Biosciences, Inc., a biotechnology company, develops therapeutic candidates for the treatment of viral diseases worldwide. Its pipeline includes long-acting helicase-primase inhibitors candidates, including ABI-5366 and ABI-1179, which are in Phase 1 clinical studies for recurrent genital herpes; and ABI-6250, an orally bioavailable hepatitis delta virus entry inhibitor that is in Phase 1a clinical study for the treatment of chronic hepatitis delta virus (HDV) infection.
